title: 第二章 上武当第十四章 真人的骚操作
content_zh:
六月四日。
三天之期已到。
中午。
林凡早已穿上蓝色儒生服，头戴儒冠，腰佩长剑，站在阳台上，透过窗户看向了天空。
那里除了三个世界之外，光芒蠕动，又出现了五个光团，朦朦胧胧，犹如水面波纹，看不真切。
那是新的五个世界，依次为：庆余年，倚天屠龙，天龙八部，陆小凤传奇，神秘复苏。
“神秘复苏？”林凡的眼睛瞬间瞪圆了，忍不住倒吸一口凉气。
这是人能去的地方？
谁选这个世界谁倒霉。
知道情况或许还能苟着。
若是不清楚到处乱逛，绝对会体验死亡前的恐惧。
“第二轮就出现这等世界？”林凡忍不住摇头。
这是让人去送死呢。
他眼前忽然光线扭曲，出现了一个屏幕，分别列出了八个世界。
耳边也传来了声音。
【请在十分钟内选择进入的游戏副本世界，超过时间，随机传送】
【提醒：每个世界，都只能进入一千新人。返回曾经去过的世界，不在此列限制】
林凡瞳孔一缩，快速分析。
先将神秘复苏世界排除。
再排除有可能买一份糖炒栗子就会被毒死的陆小凤传奇。

天龙八部相对好些，里面不但有无量山琅嬛福地，还有擂鼓山逍遥子的七十年功力。
可他没有武学基础，即使先段誉一步得到琅嬛福地的北冥神功，他也无法修炼。
至于擂鼓山？
他一个普通人，能够安全到达那里？
庆余年？
机缘少些，相对安全。
倚天屠龙？
林凡猛然想到了一种可能。
“要是成功，我能得到巨大的好处，至少能苟着成长。即使失败，也有丐帮保底。”
“赌了！”
林凡立即选择了倚天屠龙世界。
【此游戏世界人数未满，选择成功】
【提醒，你可以选择大致的降临之地】
“可有地图？”
林凡试探着询问，结果没有任何回应。
没有地图，没有提示。
content_en:
June 4th.
The three-day period has come.
noon.
Lin Fan had already put on the blue scholar's uniform, a Confucian crown on his head, and a long sword on his waist. He stood on the balcony and looked at the sky through the window.
In addition to the three worlds there, the light squirmed, and five more light groups appeared. They were hazy, like ripples on the water, and could not be seen clearly.
Those are the five new worlds, in order: Qing Yu Nian, Yitian Slaying the Dragon, The Eight Parts of the Heavenly Dragon, Lu Xiaofeng's Legend, and Mysterious Resurrection.
"Mysterious resurrection?" Lin Fan's eyes widened instantly and he couldn't help but take a breath.
Is this a place where people can go?
Whoever chooses this world will be unlucky.
If you know the situation, you might still be able to survive.
If you don't know how to wander around, you will definitely experience the fear before death.
"A world like this will appear in the second round?" Lin Fan couldn't help but shake his head.
This is letting people die.
The light suddenly distorted in front of his eyes, and a screen appeared, listing eight worlds respectively.
There was also a sound in my ears.
[Please choose the game copy world to enter within ten minutes. If the time exceeds, it will be sent randomly]
[Reminder: Only one thousand new people can enter each world. Returning to the world you have been to is not restricted by this list]
Lin Fan's pupils shrank and he analyzed quickly.
First, exclude the mysterious world of recovery.
Let’s also exclude the legend of Lu Xiaofeng who might be poisoned to death if he bought a portion of roasted chestnuts with sugar.
The Eight Parts of Tianlong is relatively better. It contains not only the blessed land of Langhuan in Wuliang Mountain, but also the seventy-year skill of Xiaoyaozi in Leigu Mountain.
But he had no foundation in martial arts, so even if Duan Yu obtained the Beiming Divine Art from Langhuan Paradise, he would not be able to practice it.
As for Leigu Mountain?
How could he, an ordinary person, get there safely?
Celebrating more than a year?
There are fewer opportunities and it is relatively safe.
Relying on the sky and slaying the dragon?
Lin Fan suddenly thought of a possibility.
"If I succeed, I can get huge benefits, and at least I can grow. Even if I fail, I will be guaranteed by the beggars."
"It's a bet!"
Lin Fan immediately chose the world of Heaven and Dragon Slaying.
[The number of people in this game world is not full, the selection is successful]
[Reminder, you can choose the approximate place of arrival]
"Do you have a map?"
Lin Fan asked tentatively, but got no response.
No map, no hints.
